name: SIS 07 — Administrative Search and Basic Dashboard — Complete

nodes.name: Webhook — Staff Student Search
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Receives an authenticated student-search request.
Input: POST JSON body and Supabase bearer token.
Output: Raw webhook item.
Error behaviour: Unsupported methods are rejected; all other validation is downstream.

nodes.name: Normalize Student Search Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes and validates the search request without trusting browser role data.
Input: Webhook item.
Output: Canonical request or sanitized validation response plus operational log request.
Error behaviour: Malformed input is routed to HTTP 400/401 without calling Auth or the business RPC.

nodes.name: Search Request Valid?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes only structurally valid search requests to Supabase Auth.
Input: Normalized validation result.
Output: True branch for Auth; false branch for logged validation failure.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Log Search Validation Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Best-effort durable log for a rejected search request.
Input: Sanitized workflow-run log request.
Output: Supabase logging response.
Error behaviour: A logging outage never blocks the public response.

nodes.name: Respond Search Validation Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns a sanitized validation or missing-token response.
Input: Normalized failure response.
Output: HTTP 400 or 401 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Supabase Auth — Validate Search User
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Validates the staff bearer token against Supabase Auth.
Input: Bearer token and anon API key from environment.
Output: Full, never-error Auth response.
Error behaviour: Two bounded attempts for transport failures; provider details stay private.

nodes.name: Classify Search Authentication
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies the Auth response and discards provider internals.
Input: Supabase Auth response and normalized request.
Output: Verified user context or sanitized HTTP 401 response plus log request.
Error behaviour: Invalid/expired tokens are permanent and not retried.

nodes.name: Search User Authenticated?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Allows only a verified Supabase user to reach the search RPC.
Input: Classified Auth result.
Output: True branch to build RPC; false branch to logged HTTP 401.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Log Search Authentication Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Best-effort durable log for invalid or expired search sessions.
Input: Sanitized workflow-run log request.
Output: Supabase logging response.
Error behaviour: A logging outage never blocks HTTP 401.

nodes.name: Respond Search Authentication Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns a sanitized authentication failure.
Input: Classified Auth failure.
Output: HTTP 401 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Build Search RPC Envelope
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Adds only the verified Supabase identity to the canonical search envelope.
Input: Verified Auth user and normalized request.
Output: User-JWT RPC request.
Error behaviour: Browser-supplied role and identity values are ignored.

nodes.name: Supabase RPC — Search Students using user JWT
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Calls the public search RPC with the same verified user JWT.
Input: Canonical p_request, bearer token, anon API key.
Output: Full, never-error PostgREST response.
Error behaviour: Two bounded transport attempts; permanent RPC errors are not retried.

nodes.name: Normalize Search RPC Response
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes success, empty results, authorization failures and transport failures.
Input: PostgREST response and canonical request.
Output: Predictable public response, HTTP status, and sanitized workflow log request.
Error behaviour: Never returns SQL, private schemas, tokens, or raw provider errors.

nodes.name: Log Search Workflow Run
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the durable final outcome of the search execution.
Input: Sanitized workflow-run request.
Output: Supabase logging response.
Error behaviour: Best effort; failure cannot change the business response.

nodes.name: Respond Student Search
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns the final student-search contract.
Input: Normalized public response.
Output: HTTP 200/400/403/502/503 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.
